card.name: Cyber Jar
card.officialText: FLIP: Destroy all monsters on the field, then both players reveal the top 5 cards from their Decks, then Special Summon all revealed Level 4 or lower monsters in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, also add any remaining cards to their hand. (If either player has less than 5 cards in their Deck, reveal as many as possible.)

design.trigger: Flip Summon real only; effect-flip/normal summon rejected.
design.destroy: All face-up and face-down monsters on both shared fields are destroyed; physical cards move to team GY; tokens cease to exist.
design.reveal: Each active team reveals up to five cards from its current representative's Deck; fewer than five is valid and does not itself cause deck-out.
design.summon: Level 4 or lower non-Fusion/non-Ritual monsters are Special Summoned up to three available Monster Zones; each can be face-up Attack or face-down Defense; non-eligible and excess cards go to hand.
design.ownership: Only active representatives' Decks are used; partner reserve Decks/hands untouched; UID owner persists.
design.idempotency: activationId persisted in JSON; replay rejected after success or negation.
design.limits: 3 Monster Zones, 3 Spell/Trap Zones, separate Field Zone, Extra Deck 5, hand limit 6 at End Phase.
